description: This file is a shell script used for testing the paging behavior and configuration of a Git repository, including external commands, environment variables, and terminal interactions.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine the expected outcome and the test command to execute, setting global variables accordingly.

methods.name: test_default_pager
methods.description: Tests if the default pager is used when expected.

methods.name: test_PAGER_overrides
methods.description: Verifies that the environment variable PAGER overrides the default pager setting.

methods.name: test_core_pager_overrides
methods.description: Tests if core repository configuration for core.pager overrides other settings.

methods.name: test_local_config_ignored
methods.description: Checks behavior when local repository config for core.pager is intentionally ignored.

methods.name: test_core_pager
methods.description: General test for core.pager configuration with various environment setups.

methods.name: test_core_pager_subdir
methods.description: Tests behavior of core.pager setting in a subdirectory context.

methods.name: test_no_local_config_subdir
methods.description: Checks behavior when local config is not used in subdirectory.

methods.name: test_pager_subdir_helper
methods.description: Helper function to test core.pager in subdirectories.

methods.name: test_GIT_PAGER_overrides
methods.description: Verifies that GIT_PAGER environment variable overrides core.pager setting.

methods.name: test_doesnt_paginate
methods.description: Checks that no pager is used in certain command invocations.

methods.name: test_pager_choices
methods.description: Runs a suite of tests on different pager configuration scenarios.
